description: A null number as an operand of || is an error, since number doesn't convert to bool
notes: The spec says a null converts to a null of any other type, regardless of the other conversion rules, so the null number should convert to a null bool (what || then does with a null is a separate question). go-cty passes a null through a conversion only when the types themselves convert (getConversion in cty/convert/conversion.go finds the conversion by type before looking at the value), so hashicorp/hcl reports that a bool is required. The null keyword, a null bool and a null string all convert, and || true then gives true.
